title: DRV-095: Letter direction encoding is ineffective on tested CGUSB-ST4; numeric dialect confirmed, DEC orientation needs qualification.
summary: Hardware confirmed that letter n/s/e/w commands are silently ineffective on the tested CGUSB-ST4, while digits 0–3 activate NYX-101 ST4 and move motors. Next: implement numeric encoding; resolve setup-specific DEC inversion before claiming full compass-direction acceptance. No production fix applied.
